title: OS command execution via os.cmd (erlang) — review required
description: The erlang sink os.cmd launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via open_port with args.
remediation: Use open_port with args with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any os.cmd call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
